snippet.title: Plum Road Tea Dream - Developer Spotlight "Samuel Baidoo" @ Black Voices in Gaming Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
During the Black Voices in Gaming Showcase, Samuel Baidoo has announced that their upcoming title Plum Road Tea Dream will be launching for PC (via Steam) in July 2026.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206340/Plum_Road_Tea_Dream/

Plum Road Tea Dream is an autobiographical adventure about pain, identity, and the rituals we create to heal.

As you assist S. in coming to terms with different types of grief, Plum Road Tea Dream invites players to slow down, reflect, and embrace every version of themselves

Videography and editing by Sid Dankers
